verdict.rationale: Canny has a documented API/developer platform and an MCP server that exposes several workflow actions (update statuses, link deals, reply to customers, query roadmap) from within an LLM, suggesting meaningful parity between chat/API and UI actions. However, there's no evidence of a published OpenAPI spec (all candidate URLs 404) or explicit documentation confirming full feature parity between the API and UI, so completeness is unverified. Missing for 10: OpenAPI/full API reference confirming coverage, explicit parity statement or independent test showing all UI actions are API-accessible.
